name: CM29_everything_carries
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (if you do something in our world it carries)
statement: Effects carry instead of resetting: frame advantage, momentum (flow, bank, recoil), posture and stamina carry between exchanges; world facts carry between ticks; every world event has a cause chain back to the actions that made it, and each action's counterfactual impact is measured.
